english.note: Use 形狀 as the all-purpose noun for an object's visible outline or geometric form.
Use this for the visible shape or physical structure of a thing or person.
Use this for the shape or form of something, including a geometrical shape.
Use 形狀 when this sense focuses on the external or geometric form of a solid or face.
